extraction.freshnessCheck: same origin as stardust/state.json site.originUrl; newest pages/*.json _provenance.fetchedAt is today (2026-11-17) < 7 days

assumptions: Primary conversion action assumed to be a project enquiry via /contact (the only form on the site; no other CTA exists).
Audience assumed to be Madison-area homeowners and community/non-profit boards, per PRODUCT.md (inferred from project copy).
Core Web Vitals sampled on 5 representative pages (/, /about, /residential, /green-ribbon, /copy-of-iowa) rather than all 48; all pages share the same Wix runtime.
Social icon links, footer year and placeholder alt values read from the captured HTML of 2026-11-17; _brand-extraction.json's '© 2015 … unlinked' is superseded.
The brief's premise that project slideshows are 'mostly 1024px source images' was tested against Wix gallery data and not confirmed (16% <=1024px); the finding is framed on display size instead.

brand-expression.basis: 40-anchor matched (brand share 0.01% < 5%, Wix theme tokens unrelated to brand, Arial-only) and template placeholders live; below anchor.

visual-hierarchy-craft.basis: 40-anchor: ad-hoc scale, carousel-as-homepage dominating the hero; plus fixed canvas and collapsed mobile site.

conversion-focus.basis: Worse than the 40-anchor: no primary CTA anywhere, what-it-is absent from home, Contact hidden in a dropdown, portfolio reachable only by nav.

accessibility.basis: 40-anchor alt failure (45% empty, 4% text alt) with unlabeled form and failing interactive contrast; landmarks and body contrast pass.

technical-seo.basis: Crawlable/indexable (robots sane, sitemap valid, self-canonicals, https) = 70-band traits, but 0/48 descriptions and wordmark H1s = 40-band traits; interpolated.

content-llm-visibility.basis: Key facts exist in crawlable SSR text (AI readability 84-99%) but home has 0 words, no Organization schema, headings are the wordmark; llms.txt present but inaccurate.

performance.basis: 40-anchor: mobile TBT poor on all sampled pages (lab); mobile LCP needs-improvement; CLS good; desktop good.

detail.note: Brand hue = accent #ea04b8 (the only saturated captured color). 80% of painted samples are photograph pixels matching no palette entry; navy-nearest samples include dark photo pixels.

No CTA label on any of 48 pages falls in a CTA-equivalence bucket; the only non-nav, non-URL labels are 'Press to Zoom' (Wix lightbox hint, 39x incl. '_press to zoom') and 'Send' (contact form, 1x). There is no conversion CTA to fragment.
h1 28 is the firm wordmark on every page, not a page title
photography has 6 h1 elements: wordmark, 'Photography', 4 empty (zero-width space)

aiReadability.method: skills/deploy/scripts/ai-readability.mjs (ChatGPT-User UA, no JS vs rendered DOM, landmarks excluded)

PageSpeed Insights API was network-reachable without a key but returned HTTP 429 (daily quota exhausted) — field data (CrUX/INP) unavailable. Lab TBT is a proxy for INP. Desktop run unthrottled on a fast datacenter link; treat desktop LCP as a best case.

findings.title: No meta description on any of the 48 pages

evidence.observed: metaDescriptions = 0/48; og:description 0/48

findings.businessImpact: Google writes its own snippet from nav labels and the wordmark; every result reads the same and nothing tells a searcher this is a Madison architect.
findings.fix: Write a 140-160 character description per page. Projects: '<Project> — <client type> <scope> in <location>. Designed by Barnett Architecture, Madison WI.' Home/about: who, where, since 2007, what kinds of work.

findings.title: Every page's only real H1 is the firm wordmark

evidence.observed: first H1 = "Barnett Architecture LLC" on 48/48 pages; /photography has 6 H1s (4 empty)

findings.businessImpact: Search engines and screen readers get the same headline on all 48 pages, so no page ranks for its own subject (project name, collection, service).
findings.fix: Render the wordmark as a logo link (not a heading); give each page one H1 with its subject ('Green Ribbon — whole-house re-imagining, Madison WI'); remove empty H1s on /photography.

findings.title: Home page states nothing — zero body text

evidence.observed: home body words = 0; AI-readability rendered words on / = 34 (wordmark + footer only); screenshot index.png: wordmark, nav, one slideshow photo

findings.businessImpact: An answer engine or first-time visitor landing on / cannot learn what the firm does, where, or for whom; AI summaries fall back to the Wix-generated llms.txt.
findings.fix: Add an 80-150 word introduction on home: 'Barnett Architecture is a design-focused architectural practice in Madison, Wisconsin, founded in 2007 by architect Todd Barnett…' plus links to Residential, Commercial and Contact.

findings.title: Firm facts (location, founding year, services) are absent from structured data; NAP appears only on /contact

evidence.observed: JSON-LD: WebSite{name:"barnett-architecture"} on 1/48 pages, no Organization/LocalBusiness; address + phone in body text only on contact: 118 North Breese Terrace Suite I, Madison, WI 53726-4133, 608-233-4538

findings.businessImpact: Local and AI search cannot attach the firm to Madison or to architecture services; 'architect near me' and 'who designed X' answers skip it.
findings.fix: Site-wide JSON-LD ProfessionalService (additionalType Architect) with name 'Barnett Architecture LLC', address, telephone, email, foundingDate 2007, founder Todd Barnett, areaServed Madison/Dane County WI, sameAs; repeat NAP in the footer on every page.

findings.title: Projects are discoverable only through dropdown menus — no project index, no links from the listing pages

evidence.observed: 29 project pages; /residential body = 0 words (photo credit), /commercial = 0; both are a single slideshow with 0 in-content project links; Residential dropdown 22 children, Commercial 7

findings.businessImpact: Prospects see one slideshow per category and must hover a 22-item menu to find comparable work; most of the portfolio is effectively hidden, and crawlers see it only through nav links.
findings.fix: Turn /residential and /commercial into project index grids (lead photo, name, type, location) and link them from home.

findings.title: No call to action anywhere; Contact is buried and its button is low-contrast

evidence.observed: ctas on 48 pages = nav labels + 'Press to Zoom' + 'Send'; Contact sits under the About dropdown (0x0 until hover, impeccable audit); Send button white on #999999 = 2.85:1

findings.businessImpact: A visitor who likes a project has no next step; enquiries depend on the visitor hunting for Contact.
findings.fix: Make Contact a top-level nav item, end every project with 'Start a project like this' linking to /contact, and put phone + email in the footer.

findings.title: Images have no usable alt text

evidence.observed: 136/304 rendered images empty alt (45%), 64 more '_' or '.'; content images with any text alt 8/208; photography 298 photos with alt = 0

findings.businessImpact: Blind visitors get nothing from a portfolio that is almost entirely photographs; image search cannot index the work.
findings.fix: Write alt per photo: subject + project + view ('Green Ribbon, rear elevation with new screened porch, Madison WI'). Decorative duplicates get alt="" deliberately.

findings.title: Active-nav magenta and the Send button fail WCAG AA

evidence.observed: #ea04b8 on #ffffff = 4.03:1 (12px nav label); #ffffff on #999999 = 2.85:1 (Send)

findings.businessImpact: Low-vision visitors cannot read the current location or the form's only action.
findings.fix: Darken the accent to >=4.5:1 (e.g. #b8008f) or mark the active item with weight/underline; Send button dark fill (#1e2f3b, 13.77:1 with white).

findings.title: Contact form fields have no labels

evidence.observed: Name and Email are placeholder-only (no <label>); empty submit shows only the browser default message

findings.businessImpact: Screen-reader and autofill users struggle with the site's only conversion point.
findings.fix: Visible <label> per field, required markers, inline error text.

findings.title: Mobile Total Blocking Time is poor on every sampled page

evidence.observed: mobile TBT 1861-1957 ms (poor > 600; 4x CPU throttle, lab); ~963-989 KB JavaScript, 132-148 requests per page for a static portfolio

findings.businessImpact: On mid-range phones the page stays unresponsive for ~2 s after it appears; lab TBT is the proxy for INP.
findings.fix: Rebuild as static HTML (Edge Delivery) with no framework runtime; until then remove unused Wix apps and the tag manager.

findings.title: Titles carry the Wix site-name slug and no value term

evidence.observed: 48/48 titles end ' | barnett-architecture'; examples "1990-2006", "2007-Current", "tHree Gables", "Potter Studio +"; 0 duplicates

findings.businessImpact: Results show a hyphenated slug instead of the firm name, and nothing signals 'architect' or 'Madison'; testimonial pages titled by year range are unclickable.
findings.fix: Set the Wix site name to 'Barnett Architecture'; title pattern '<Subject> — <type>, <city> | Barnett Architecture' under 60 chars; retitle the two testimonial pages.

findings.title: Wix-generated slugs unrelated to page content

evidence.observed: 27 of 48 slugs are copy-of-* or /blank; e.g. /copy-of-folded-roof-2 = "Potter Studio +"; /blank = "40's Re-Make"; /copy-of-illinois = "Wisconsin"; /copy-of-iowa-color = "Illinois"; /copy-of-mexico-places-1 = "Minnesota"; /copy-of-minnesota = "Iowa 2022 Exhbit"

findings.businessImpact: URLs mislead users and crawlers (/copy-of-illinois is Wisconsin) and waste the one ranking signal every page has.
findings.fix: Rename to descriptive slugs under /projects/ and /photography/ (e.g. /projects/potter-studio) with 301 redirects from every old URL.

findings.title: Structured data limited to one WebSite entity on the home page

evidence.observed: pages with JSON-LD = 1/48; types {"WebSite":1}; name "barnett-architecture"

findings.businessImpact: No rich-result or knowledge-panel eligibility; projects and photo collections are invisible as entities.
findings.fix: Per page type: ProfessionalService (site-wide), CreativeWork/Place for each project (name, locationCreated, about, image), ImageGallery for each photography collection, BreadcrumbList.

findings.title: No og:image on any page although twitter:card is summary_large_image

evidence.observed: og:image 0/48, og:description 0/48, twitter:card summary_large_image 48/48

findings.businessImpact: Links shared on social or messaging apps render without a photo — a poor showing for a visual portfolio.
findings.fix: Set og:image to each page's lead photograph (1200x630) and og:description to the meta description.

findings.title: llms.txt exists but is Wix-generated and misstates the practice

evidence.observed: llms.txt summary: 'specializing in residential, library, religious, educational, and healthcare projects' — sourced from Todd Barnett's career history on /team; portfolio is 22 residential + 7 commercial/civic; lists only the home link

findings.businessImpact: AI assistants that read llms.txt describe the firm as a healthcare/library specialist and get no route to the projects.
findings.fix: Replace with an authored llms.txt: one-paragraph firm summary (Madison WI, 2007, residential renovations/additions/new homes, community buildings), contact block, and a linked list of projects and collections.

findings.title: Project pages never state the project name in the page body

evidence.observed: 21/29 project pages lack the project name in body text; it appears only in <title> and nav; project pages have no h2/h3

findings.businessImpact: Answer engines cannot connect a narrative ('A young couple bought a foreclosed house…') to the project it describes.
findings.fix: Lead each project with H1 name and a facts line: client type · location · scope · year (year is stated on only 4 project pages).

findings.title: No filters by project type or location, no site search

evidence.observed: facet data already on every project: clientType 8 values (Private Residence 21), location 7 values (Madison, WI 23); search forms 0

findings.businessImpact: A homeowner looking for 'kitchen' or 'addition' work, or a board looking for civic work, cannot narrow 29 projects.
findings.fix: Tag projects by type (new home, addition, remodel, kitchen, multi-family, civic/community) and location; filter chips on the project index.

findings.title: Body text set at 13px (11px on the Wix mobile site)

evidence.observed: 173 of 183 sampled text nodes at 13px Arial 400; mobile live body 11-14px

findings.businessImpact: Project narratives, the site's only differentiating copy, are tiring to read, especially for the older homeowners the practice serves.
findings.fix: Body 17-18px, line length 60-70ch, with a real heading scale.

findings.title: Photography collections: ~300 images, almost all untitled

evidence.observed: 298 photos in 8 collections: title empty 69, placeholder ('_','-','=') 226, camera filename 3; alt 0; description 0; gallery pages with 0 body words 6/8

findings.businessImpact: The exhibited photography (Fields of Vision 2024, Iowa 2022) is unsearchable and uncitable; no place names or years are machine-readable.
findings.fix: Caption every photo with place, county/state and year; add a 50-100 word introduction per collection; ImageGallery schema.

findings.title: Project photography displayed small inside a fixed 980px canvas

evidence.observed: project slides render at 646x443 on a 1440 viewport; source long edge >2000px for 97/156 photos, <=1024px for 25 (exactly 1024: 6); portraits cropped to landscape

findings.businessImpact: The work is the product, yet it is shown at under half the screen width; the high-resolution originals the firm already owns are wasted.
findings.fix: Full-bleed responsive gallery with srcset up to 2400w and aspect-aware frames; re-export the ~25 sub-1024px images or keep them at smaller sizes.

findings.title: Home is an uncaptioned slideshow (carousel-as-homepage)

evidence.observed: 9-photo slideshow, no caption or link; LCP image on / is the same file as /green-ribbon's lead photo (5c8b97_b1d8e90c...)

findings.businessImpact: Visitors see a good house and cannot find out which project it is or open it.
findings.fix: A hero with the practice statement and a captioned, linked featured project, followed by the project index.

findings.title: Flat, ad-hoc type hierarchy in a single weight

evidence.observed: headings 28/24/18px, weight 400 only; project label 'Private Residence' 15px over 13px body (1.15 ratio, impeccable)

findings.businessImpact: Nothing on a project page tells the eye where to start; pages read as undifferentiated grey text beside a photo.
findings.fix: Modular scale (e.g. 1.25) with a display face for names and a distinct meta style for type/location.

findings.title: Brand accent appears only on the active nav label; the chrome is the Wix template's

evidence.observed: #ea04b8 = 0.01% of painted pixels on index.png; used as text only, 48x (T-color-imbalance); Wix theme action blue #5b8db0 declared but never rendered; Arial 400 only

findings.businessImpact: Nothing in the chrome is ownable or connected to the work; the site reads as a 2015 template rather than a design practice.
findings.fix: Define a small owned palette drawn from the photography and a distinctive type pairing; retire the magenta or give it a deliberate role.

findings.title: Template placeholders still live: social links, favicon, copyright

evidence.observed: social icons link to http://www.twitter.com/wix and http://www.facebook.com/; favicon static.parastorage.com/client/pfavico.ico on 48/48 pages (also apple-touch-icon); footer '© 2021'

findings.businessImpact: Template leftovers signal an unmaintained site to prospects comparing architects.
findings.fix: Remove or correct social links, ship a brand favicon set (SVG + 180px touch icon), current copyright with the address line.

findings.title: Heading order skips and unnamed gallery controls

evidence.observed: /residential H1 -> H6; /contact empty H2 then wordmark H6; gallery slides role=button with no accessible name (impeccable audit)

findings.businessImpact: Screen-reader users cannot navigate by headings or know what a slide button does.
findings.fix: Ordered h1-h3 per page; name slide controls from the photo caption or remove the button role.

findings.title: Fixed 980px desktop canvas plus a separate collapsed mobile site

evidence.observed: desktop UA at 375px: scrollWidth 1160 vs 375; phone UA gets a 320px Wix mobile site whose home is wordmark + one 286x380 crop (613-652px tall); touch targets <44px on 15/18 controls

findings.businessImpact: Phone visitors — most first visits — see the least of the work and small targets.
findings.fix: One fluid, responsive layout; 44px minimum targets; project index as the second screen on mobile.

findings.title: Mobile LCP needs improvement on image-led pages

evidence.observed: mobile LCP / 2.84s, /green-ribbon 3.64s, /residential 2.92s (needs-improvement 2.5-4.0s); desktop LCP all good (best case, unthrottled)

findings.businessImpact: The first photograph — the whole pitch — arrives late on phones.
findings.fix: Serve the LCP image from static HTML with fetchpriority=high on that image only, preload it, lazy-load the remaining slides.

findings.title: Generic Wix favicon in tabs and search results

evidence.observed: pfavico.ico on 48/48 pages

findings.businessImpact: Google shows a favicon next to mobile results; the Wix icon makes the listing look generic.
findings.fix: Brand favicon (SVG + ICO + 180px apple-touch-icon).

findings.title: Sitemap valid but carries no image entries and one bulk lastmod

evidence.observed: sitemap index -> pages-sitemap.xml, 48 URLs (= crawl); lastmod values ["2026-10-05"]; image entries 0

findings.businessImpact: Search engines get no hint of ~450 portfolio photographs or of which pages actually changed.
findings.fix: Image sitemap entries (or image:image per URL) with captions; real per-page lastmod after the migration.

findings.title: http apex redirects in two hops

evidence.observed: http://barnettarchitecture.com -> https://barnettarchitecture.com -> https://www.barnettarchitecture.com

findings.businessImpact: Minor crawl and latency cost on old links.
findings.fix: Redirect every variant to https://www.barnettarchitecture.com in one 301.

findings.title: Every slide requested at high priority, none lazy-loaded

evidence.observed: AVIF served for 208/208 content image URLs, sized to the rendered box (good); loading=auto and fetchpriority=high on every sampled slide

findings.businessImpact: Off-screen slides compete with the LCP image for bandwidth on mobile.
findings.fix: Keep AVIF + exact sizing; one fetchpriority=high LCP image, loading=lazy for the rest, srcset for 2x desktops.

findings.title: Console errors on every page from the Wix runtime

evidence.observed: console errors per page 1-5; 15-16 hosts contacted per page

findings.businessImpact: Noise rather than visible breakage, but a symptom of the heavy third-party stack.
findings.fix: Resolved by the static rebuild; until then audit installed Wix apps.

upliftDirections.pitch: Tomorrow's version of the site you have today.
upliftDirections.summary: Same seven-section IA re-platformed to static Edge Delivery: H1 per page, descriptions, ProfessionalService + CreativeWork JSON-LD, a home introduction, Contact in the top nav with an enquiry CTA on every project, 17px body on a modular scale, labelled form, AA contrast, descriptive slugs with 301s.

upliftDirections.pitch: What if we amplified the photography?
upliftDirections.summary: The ~450 captured photographs (most >2000px originals) become the compositional spine: full-bleed project galleries, a filterable project index by type and location, photography collections as captioned exhibitions with place and year.

upliftDirections.pitch: What if motion was part of the identity?
upliftDirections.summary: Same IA as A; slow, reading-paced editorial motion — photographs settling into frame, project facts revealing alongside the narrative — matching the plain-spoken, craft-minded voice (register per motion-registers.md: editorial / slow-paced).
